name: Google Antigravity
summary: Google's agentic coding platform (app, IDE, CLI, IDE extensions and Python SDK) for orchestrating autonomous subagents, scheduled tasks and code verification.
description: Per its llms.txt: Antigravity app (command center for background agents), Antigravity IDE, Antigravity CLI, extensions for VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio, Zed and Xcode, and a Python SDK for custom agents, tools and MCP integrations. Plans, credits and enterprise tiers are listed on the pricing page.
